question: How much of the Oct-19 minimum-5 paired gap (400k model vs 200k scaled, median +0.879%) remains when fees are charged only on changed share counts, and with a no-trade band?
scope: Fee-counting sensitivity on the frozen Oct-16 stock inputs; not alpha selection, not an approved execution policy, no production change
prior_exposure: Oct-16 and Oct-19 summaries read; reviewer expected the minimum-fee drag to be roughly one minimum commission per holding per month

variants.archived_value_delta: archived stock.simulate: commission on every economic value change, every name re-targeted monthly
variants.share_delta_band_0.00: integer shares carried; order only when the archived target share count differs from the held count
variants.share_delta_band_0.10/0.25/0.50: as band 0, and a held name also keeps its shares while |value - equal-weight target value| <= band * target value

band_rule: bands fixed before results; all are reported; none is selected by return
carry_rule: value/(shares*raw price) below 1.095 keeps the share count and books the residual as cash (dividends, rounded adjusted prices); above it the share count becomes floor(shares*ratio)
cash_rule: archived 1% post-fee cash reserve; shortfall restored by the archived greedy trim, kept names included
metrics: paired terminal gap (V400_end/(2*V200_end)-1): min p05 median p95 max, all and clean windows
per leg: relative NAV deviation vs the continuous no-fee 50-name theory, tracking error, orders per month, fees, post-trade weight deviation
sample_unit: paired 12-month window; 114 overlapping windows are not independent
qa: archived script and input hashes; archived value-delta replay equals Oct-16 rolling metrics; band-0 share ledger equals archived path when fees are zero; archived minimum-5 paired median equals Oct-19; Decimal ratio recomputation
limits: same archived economic monthly ledger: adjusted-return valuation, month-end same-close sizing
fees assumed (2bp, min 5, historical stamp duty), broker schedule not confirmed
no fills, slippage, T+1, suspensions, limit moves, odd-lot rules or rejections
a wider band trades fees for tracking error; tracking error and weight deviation are reported alongside
a band is a research sensitivity, not an approved execution policy
stopping_rule: run every variant once; report all; no parameter change after seeing results
